text:
elaine (pm): Dropped a compact checklist for routing/residency pilots in the doc — please quick-review. Need to lock pilots and launch gates by Wed. https://redwood.share/notes/residency-checklist :eyes:

jamal (prod): Skimming now. Two quick asks: 1) can we designate isolation per-route (payments only) vs whole-tenant? 2) what's the default for fallback (allowed/denied)?

samir (arch): Strong preference for route-scoped isolation (keeps opt-in smaller). Fallback should be explicit per-policy: allow_soft_fallback | deny_hard_fallback. Also want a "degraded-model" fallback option (smaller variant in-region).

miguel (eng): Tech note: "deny_hard_fallback" means reserved capacity or node pinning. This reduces bin-packing efficiency. I'll run a 3-customer sizing delta once we pick pilots.

nina (sre): Ops checklist (draft): canary 5-10%, stability window 20m, p95 latency <=1.8x baseline, fallback-alert if >1 fallback/min, synthetic probe every 1m per-region. Runbook: canary -> monitor latency,error-rate,fallbacks -> rollback on error>0.5% or fallback_count>3 in 10m.

trina (cs): Customer feedback: both FinCo and Acme requested route-level residency + audit trail of routing decisions. They asked for plain-language policy summaries for contracts.

harry (legal): We'll need that summary + retention period for audit logs. Propose minimal event set: policy_id, matched_route, chosen_region, fallback_reason, timestamp. Also include a paragraph describing typical failover behavior for customers to sign.

samir (arch): Minimal policy DSL to show product/legal:
```
policy payments_eu {
  match: customer=="FinCo" && route=="payments"
  isolation: hard
  regions: [eu-west-1]
  fallback: {allowed: false, degraded_model: null}
}
```

miguel (eng): Also include autoscale defaults in the policy: min_reserved=1, max_burst=2x, eviction_window=5m. If product doesn't pick them we'll pick conservative defaults (costly).

elaine (pm): Draft launch gates: 1) 99.5% regional success across 24h canary, 2) pilot cost cap acknowledged, 3) in-region KMS if residency required, 4) legal + CS sign-off on policy summaries. Any objections?

jamal (prod): No objections. I'll add the pilot candidates to the matrix: FinCo (high ARR, payments hard), Acme (mid ARR, payments preferred), BetaLabs (low ARR, end-to-end soft).

nina (sre): I'll prepare the runbook and synthetic checks. Also adding alerts for 'policy_fallback_rate' and 'policy_hit_rate'.

miguel (eng): I'll sketch sizing + token-cost delta for the three pilots (ETA Tue). Callout: hard isolation may need 20-40% more GPU headroom depending on load patterns.

trina (cs): I'll prep customer comms template that lists in-scope routes, expected failover behavior, and audit retention.

harry (legal): I'll draft simple contract language and retention terms; will pair with Trina to keep plain language.

samir (arch): Telemetry dependency: every policy eval must emit event(policy_id, outcome, chosen_region, fallback_reason). Console needs a per-policy dashboard (hits, fallbacks, econ delta).

deploy-bot: deploy queued: infra/policy-telemetry v0.4 -> staging (triggered by samir).

elaine (pm): Actions recap: product finalize matrix by Mon EOD; eng sizing Tue; SRE runbook + probes Tue; legal + CS policy summary Tue. We'll pick two pilots Wed and send customers the onramp note. Thanks! :rocket:
